title: SynCo: Synthetic Community-Aware Attributed Graph Generator for Graph Neural Network Benchmarking
abstract: arXiv:2609.10742v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are powerful models for handling attributed graphs in tasks such as classification, link prediction, and community detection, as they enable the aggregation of information from both structural and semantic sources. However, progress in community detection is hindered by the lack of high-quality datasets, since ground-truth community labels are often unavailable and most algorithms proposed in recent literature rely on the same benchmark datasets for model training and evaluation. To address this issue, attributed random graph generators are commonly employed to create synthetic graphs for assessing the strengths and limitations of GNN-based models. Nevertheless, most existing generators rely heavily on power-law degree distributions, despite recent evidence indicating that scale-free networks are rare, particularly in social network contexts. translated_title: SynCo：用于图神经网络基准测试的社区感知合成属性图生成器
translated_abstract: 图神经网络（GNN）是处理属性图的强大模型，可应用于分类、链接预测和社区检测等任务，因为它们能够聚合来自结构和语义两种来源的信息。然而，社区检测的进展受到高质量数据集缺乏的阻碍，原因在于真实的社区标签往往不可获得，且近期文献中提出的大多数算法都依赖相同的基准数据集进行模型训练和评估。为解决这一问题，属性随机图生成器通常被用来创建合成图，以评估基于GNN的模型的优势和局限性。然而，尽管近期证据表明无标度网络很少见，尤其是在社交网络场景中，大多数现有生成器仍然严重依赖幂律度分布。此外，最先进的属性图生成器提供的……（摘要内容在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了SynCo——一个社区感知的合成属性图生成器，用于图神经网络基准测试，解决了现有生成器过度依赖幂律度分布、与真实社交网络特征不符的问题。
en_tdlr: SynCo is a community-aware synthetic attributed graph generator for GNN benchmarking, addressing the issue that existing generators heavily rely on power-law degree distributions despite evidence that scale-free networks are rare in real-world social networks.
